slides.title: What changed this week
bullets: Reviewed res-0.6 calls: TNK, stromal, B subsets
v4 rebuild: DecontX, QC floor, routing, myeloid/endothelial subsets
TNK 16 dropped, not routed to myeloid
slides.notes:
All commits on branch origin/protect-lineage-markers. No captioned figures were committed this week.

ffadeb2: Add reviewed res-0.6 cluster calls for the TNK, stromal and B subsets. One table per v3 subset with the first-draft call per cluster, the reviewer's label, call and note, a check_result column (doublet scores, nCount, dataset enrichment over baseline), and the machine-readable action / route_to / followup / lineage_reviewed columns that the routing step reads. Draft columns are kept unedited; the reviewer columns win.

58e322d: Rebuild v4: DecontX, QC floor, reviewed routing, myeloid and endothelial subsets. 02a (new) applies the reviewed calls per cell: keep, drop, or route to another subset. 01d (new) runs DecontX per sample on the whole atlas, so every contamination source is in the run. Its cell-type labels are the reviewed lineages, then level3: with level2 B/plasma as one label, B cells came out ~98% contamination. It also applies a per dataset x compartment 3-MAD floor on nFeature and nCount. 02 builds five subsets (myeloid with mast, endothelial new). Each has a decontX assay as default plus raw RNA. Neutrophil-like cells are kept. 02b-04b handle the five subsets and a native-lineage set (T+NK, B+plasma) in the gate. 02b protects lineage markers in the new subsets. 04 adds a dissociation score. 03 also runs Harmony on sample_key as a comparison (mixing, same-tissue neighbours, ARI). io.R holds the directories: v3 inputs, v4 outputs in rebuild_v4. run_v4.sh chains everything; run_v3.sh now covers 00m-01c only.

c450f75: Drop TNK 16 instead of routing it to myeloid; document call overrides. After the first v4 DecontX run, the TNK 16 cells routed to myeloid as neutrophils had a median 21.9% hemoglobin and 0.67 contamination. The level3 neutrophils in the same dataset had 0.15% and 0.106. Because TNK 16 shared the neutrophil DecontX label, hemoglobin had also become native to the GSE205013 neutrophil profile. TNK 16 is now dropped, with its own DecontX label (RBC_lowquality). reviewer_call is unchanged, and check_result records the evidence. Both READMEs explain that action can override reviewer_call.
